name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard is the lone commanded step, since the soft Existence(target_picked_up) forces nothing. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard keeps the 'then' order, because the 'if possible' cue covers only the box step. Soft Existence(target_picked_up) matches the preference.

texts: Open the door (door_open must become true at least once).
Door must be open before the box is picked up (ordering from 'then').
If possible, pick up the box in the other room (target_picked_up at least once).
